summary.en: Embedded SQL database; the 3.54.0 command-line tools ship as a Windows arm64 zip.
summary.zh-TW: 內嵌式 SQL 資料庫；3.54.0 命令列工具提供 Windows arm64 壓縮檔。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: Only the winget manifest's installer architecture was confirmed; runtime behavior is untested.
caveats.zh-TW: 只確認 winget 資訊清單中的安裝檔架構，執行行為尚未驗證。
